title: Nobodaddy
html_source:
Nobodaddy
n.
c.1793, William Blake’s derisive name for the anthropomorphic God of Christianity.
Dictionary.com

Nobodaddy, a ‘portmanteau word’ for ‘Nobody’s Daddy’, antithetical to ‘Father of All’
